# Sownmark Solutions

> India's leading full-service digital marketing and custom software agency.

## Services Offered
- **Digital Marketing**: Full-funnel digital marketing services, performance advertising, and growth strategy.
- **Search Engine & Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO/AEO/SEO)**: Getting brands cited by traditional engines and generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini).
- **Display Advertising**: Programmatic advertising, GDN placement, high-converting banner and video ad creation.
- **Social Media Management**: Organic social growth, content strategy, brand community engagement.
- **Web & Software Development**: React, Next.js, Node.js, SaaS development, CRM & ERP custom architecture.
- **Hiring & Talent Solutions**: Tech and marketing talent recruitment and staffing.
